fullPassage:
The Cambridge Declaration of Consciousness

In 2012, scientists met at the University of Cambridge to talk about consciousness in humans and animals. Consciousness means having subjective experiences or awareness. The scientists found that animals have emotions and can have consciousness like humans. For example, African grey parrots have shown evidence of consciousness that is almost as advanced as that of humans. Even octopuses have the brain structures needed for subjective experiences. Drugs that affect human consciousness also affect some animals in similar ways. So, the scientists concluded that consciousness is not just for humans. Animals can have it too.

Since the Cambridge Declaration, research on animal consciousness has been actively carried out. Scientists are still working to find out exactly how animal consciousness works. Not all animals are conscious, but those with complex nervous systems are more likely to be. All things considered, it would be a wise and safe choice to assume that animals have feelings and to treat them with respect and kindness.

❌ ① scientists: 과학자를 대하라는 맥락 아님
❌ ② nervous systems: 신경계를 대한다는 것은 비문
✅ ③ animals: 'assume that animals have feelings and to treat them' — them은 animals를 가리킴 ← 정답
❌ ④ feelings: 감정을 대한다는 것은 비문
det.tip: 대명사 them: assume that animals have feelings → treat them = treat animals

questions.passage:
The Cambridge Declaration of Consciousness

In 2012, scientists met at the University of Cambridge to talk about consciousness in humans and animals. Consciousness means having subjective experiences or awareness. The scientists found that animals have emotions and can have consciousness like humans. For example, African grey parrots have shown evidence of consciousness that is almost as advanced as that of humans. Even octopuses have the brain structures needed for subjective experiences. Drugs that affect human consciousness also affect some animals in similar ways. So, the scientists concluded that consciousness is not just for humans. Animals can have it too.
questions.stem: 본문에서 찾아 다음 **영어** 단어를 찾아 (영어로) 쓰시오. "의식이란 주관적인 경험이나 인식(__________)이 있음을 의미한다.". (1단어)

det.korean: 의식이란 주관적인 경험이나 인식(awareness)이 있음을 의미한다.
det.analysis: passage에서 'having subjective experiences or awareness'를 패러프레이징. awareness가 정답
det.tip: awareness = 인식, 자각. be aware of = ~을 인식하다

questions.passage: Even octopuses have the brain structures needed for subjective experiences. Drugs that affect human consciousness also affect some animals in similar ways. So, the scientists concluded that consciousness is not just for humans. Animals can have it too. Since the Cambridge Declaration, research on animal consciousness has been actively carried out. Scientists are still working to find out exactly how animal consciousness works. Not all animals are conscious, but those with complex __________ are more likely to be. All things considered, it would be a wise and safe choice to assume that animals have feelings and to treat them with respect and kindness.
questions.stem: 다음 **영어** 표현을 찾아 (영어로) 쓰시오. "복잡한 __________를 가진 동물은 의식이 있을 가능성이 더 높다.". (2단어)

det.korean: 복잡한 신경계(nervous systems)를 가진 동물은 의식이 있을 가능성이 더 높다.
det.analysis: passage에서 'those with complex nervous systems are more likely to be'를 패러프레이징. nervous systems가 정답
det.tip: nervous system = 신경계. complex nervous systems = 복잡한 신경계

[ it / would be / a wise and safe choice / to assume / that / animals / have feelings ]. (14단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 동물에게도 감정이 있다고 가정하는 것이 현명하고 안전한 선택일 것이다.
det.analysis: 가주어 it + would be + 보어(a wise and safe choice) + 진주어(to assume that animals have feelings)
det.tip: It would be + 보어 + to V = V하는 것은 ~일 것이다. 가주어-진주어 구문

questions.ans: it would be a wise and safe choice to assume that animals have feelings

questions.passage:
The Cambridge Declaration of Consciousness

In 2012, scientists met at the University of Cambridge to talk about consciousness in humans and animals. Consciousness means having subjective experiences or awareness.
